title: Use Drei Fisheye for Curvilinear
description: Fix fisheye/curvilinear projection: pixelated image and wrong colors caused by NearestFilter capture, CSS-pixel RT size, and missing sRGB blit conversion.
summary: Evaluated pmndrs/drei <Fisheye>: it portals children into a cubemap sphere (zoom/segments/resolution only) and cannot express our curvilinear fov/strength/panini or sibling-pass mounting next to undistorted gizmo/orbit chrome. Kept WorldCurvilinearPass; borrowed HalfFloatType capture precision from drei RenderCubeTexture. Vitest 130 passed.
